name: web-yellow-backdrop-cardiology-dashboard-on-rounded-tablet
title: Cardiology Timeline Dashboard on Yellow
whatItIs: A rounded dark-framed tablet on a neon yellow backdrop showing a beige Cardiology dashboard with a curved tab header, a patient card and vitals, a horizontal timeline with medication pills, blood pressure cards with yellow charts, and a dark timeline scrubber at the bottom.
whatItMeans: A neutral beige UI with tiny yellow accents feels calm and clinical, and the neon backdrop makes the tablet pop.
techniques: Curved tab header merging into the frame
Yellow used only inside chart fills and node markers
Timeline nodes connected by thin lines
Pill toggles and rounded cards throughout
Dark bottom scrubber with icon groups
bestFor: Neutral UI with a neon presentation backdrop

vocabulary.definition: A bar for moving through periods of time.
A header with an organic curve joining its tabs.
A row of key health measurements.
